business_problem: LG AI Research needed to extend AI systems built for high-stakes manufacturing into financial market workflows where forecasting accuracy alone was insufficient; investors also needed narrative reasoning, governance, and explainability across structured and unstructured inputs before they could trust and act on model outputs.
solution_summary: LG AI Research adapted the reliability and explainability practices it developed for manufacturing forecasting to a financial-market intelligence stack centered on its in-house large language model EXAONE. The implementation combines structured time-series signals with unstructured news, disclosures, and research so the system can forecast and explain results in analyst-like language rather than emitting scores alone. EXAONE Business Intelligence operates as a multi-agent system that curates new information, forecasts economic prospects, generates equity analysis, and evaluates decision scenarios. Those outputs are then processed into the AI-Powered Equity Forecast Score, which serves institutional investors with a daily equity score and accompanying rationale over a four-week horizon. LG also validated the approach in the LQAI ETF with Qraft Technologies, using natural-language explanations alongside stock ranking and periodic rebalancing.

data_flow: Structured time-series signals and unstructured news and disclosures are ingested into EXAONE-based processing, where EXAONE Business Intelligence curates the text inputs, combines them with forecasting signals, generates equity analysis and scenario evaluations, and converts the results into the AI-Powered Equity Forecast Score and commentary consumed by institutional investors.
business_outcome: LG AI Research turned its manufacturing AI foundation into a commercial financial AI offering that delivers both forward-looking equity predictions and natural-language rationale, enabling institutional investors to interrogate forecasts with greater transparency and governance.
